I replied to Tobias in a thread on their message in #central-team: "Thanks, Tobias. Noted for the channel: expense reports are due this Friday, October 16."

The date is my own calculation. Their message was sent on Wednesday, October 14, 2026, so "Friday" is October 16. I didn't look for a deadline posted anywhere else. Nothing else needed doing: the message was just a reminder, and it didn't involve any restricted information or approvals.
